sections.markdown:
# BBRI.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp4,201.0 against Rp2,710.0 (expected total return 68.7%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The 50%-weight justified P/B rests on a sustainable ROE of 20.57% that is asserted, not built. VAL_BANKS requires NIM x leverage - credit cost - opex, each argued. 20.57% is 290bp above FY2025A (17.67%), 150bp above FY20
- The scenario set contains no state in which the shares are worth less than the price. Base 5,020, bear 3,980 and bull 6,325 (today's values) are all 47-133% above 2,710, and the engine's own NIM x credit-cost grid bottom
- Section 5 names capital and payout as risk 3 ('a shareholder that treats the bank as a revenue source can keep the payout high for another year or two') but no scenario shocks payout. The base case cuts payout from 90% t

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
